lines.text: Fill the shadow to build a bridge. Drag pieces. Tap a piece to turn it.
Fill the shadow to build a road sign. Drag pieces. Tap a piece to turn it.
Fill the shadow to build a tree house. Drag pieces. Tap a piece to turn it.
Fill the shadow to build a water slide. Drag pieces. Tap a piece to turn it.
How many squares cover this block?
Look at the grey shape. Build the same shape turned a quarter turn to the right, inside the yellow box. Drag pieces. Tap a piece to turn it. Tap Flip to flip it.
Look for a piece that does not fit yet. Move it out and try another spot.
Put the large triangle so its square corner, the right angle, is at (1,4). Count across first, then up. Then tap Check.
Tap a corner of the shape with an acute angle. That is less than 90 degrees. The white dots mark the corners.
That is one answer. Tap Check.
This right triangle has legs 3 and 3. How long is the long side, the hypotenuse? Round to tenths. Type it and tap OK.
This shadow is a tower, turned around. Fill it with all seven pieces. Drag pieces. Tap a piece to turn it. Tap Flip to flip it.
